messages:
samir: Heads up — canary kernel-selector flip (commit f2b3c1) correlated with large drop in KV prefix hit-rate on warmers. Observed hit-rate 87% -> 52% on web-qa cluster. Perf profiles attached below. Need triage ASAP :eyes:

maria: Ack. Do we have flamegraphs or perf data? Can you paste the metric query?

devon: Pasting quick perf dump and cache metrics:
```
# metrics @web-qa (last 30m)
runtime.kv_cache.hitrate: 0.52
runtime.kv_cache.hitrate:prev: 0.87
serving.kernel.selection: new_v2
p99_infer_latency_ms: 152 -> 230
batcher.qps: steady
```

Also seeing more KV eviction churn and prefix misses in logs.

anna: Was the kernel change gated? I thought warmers were still pinned to old kernels until rollout finished.

samir: It wasn't — ops autoscaler spun up nodes that got the new agent image; warmers landed there. Deploy-bot message below.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for services/serving @ f2b3c1 — target 10% traffic — enabled kernel_selector: new_v2

ops-bot: Autoscaler event at 2026-03-18T02:11: scaling +8 nodes (nodepool: warmers); new nodes booted with agent image 2026.03.17

maria: Reproducer quick-run (synthetic warmers):
```
# run synthetic warmers load
python tools/synthetic_warmer.py --profile=prefix-heavy --rate=50 --duration=300 --target=web-qa
```

devon: Quick theory: new_v2 kernel changed KV key normalization (hash salt or prefix trimming) -> cache key mismatch for stored prefixes. Also kernel might reorder attention blocks causing different memory layout -> different cache eviction ordering.

anna: Short-term mitigation: gate warmers to old kernel and re-run preseed jobs. Long-term: add a key-schema compatibility check in kernel switch path.

samir: Can someone check commit diff for kernel key hashing? @devon @maria

devon: Found diff: removed `normalize_prefix_keys=True` in kernel init (https://git.redwood/.../commit/f2b3c1). That explains immediate miss rate.

maria: Opening PR to temporarily re-enable normalization for warmers and add rollout flag. I'll also add an integ test: generate prefixes with both normalizations and assert hit parity.

anna: Also propose adding a warmers-only fallback: if observed hit-rate drops > 15% within 10m after node starts, route warmers to legacy kernels automatically.

samir: Good. Who will own the rollback/gate? @maria please, and @devon can you prod the kernel team for a patch? :thumbsup:

maria: On it. Will push a hotfix PR and schedule a short canary for warmers tomorrow.

deploy-bot: PR created: redwood/serving#4123 — hotfix: re-enable prefix normalization for warmers

samir: Thanks. After hotfix, let's monitor `runtime.kv_cache.hitrate` and `batcher.prefill_success` for next 6 hours. If no recovery, we'll roll full kernel back.

anna: Adding a follow-up: add unit in canary checklist to simulate warmers traffic as part of kernel rollout.

maria: added to checklist. :white_check_mark:

samir: Cool. Leaving notes here so ops can reference during the fix. Thanks everyone.
